new.label: modernized BcsTesoreriaJobs src/main (JobRunner + the 4 jobs + GenerarArchivoPagos / GenerarArchivoPagoBancoEstado) on the same H2 seed, the same scripted collaborators and ports, JDK 25; the proven tesoreria-service classes are Mockito mocks answering from the case

note: Each case is the canonical text of one comparison point of one golden case (outcome, exception, status listener calls, commit/rollback order, dumped tables, files written as length + SHA-256 + escaped text, directories, collaborator trace, sequences). Masks live inside the canonical text (README of the tests): yyyyMMdd_HHmmss in file names and file text as <TS>, temporary base path as ${RUTA_BASE}, OS error text, NullPointerException helpful text as <npe>, identity hashes. Not covered: real HANA behavior (types, TO_NVARCHAR, sequences; the schema is INFERRED), the real collaborator services (scripted), opencsv 3.7 (reproduced from its source, not run against the jar), the Job Manager scheduling, FTP transfer of the generated files, a missing PLA.RutaBaseArchivos in the distribution job.
